params.text:
I was unable to retrieve your RSS feed token from GitLab. Here's what I attempted:

1. Successfully logged into GitLab using the provided credentials
2. Tried to access user settings through the user avatar dropdown menu
3. Attempted direct URLs to profile pages (/-/profile and /-/profile/preferences) but received 'Page Not Found' errors
4. Searched for 'access tokens' in the search bar but found no results

Unfortunately, I could not locate the RSS feed token section. RSS feed tokens in GitLab are typically found in user settings under 'Access Tokens' or 'Personal Access Tokens', but I was unable to navigate to the correct settings page. The GitLab instance may have a different navigation structure or the RSS feed token functionality might be located elsewhere.

Recommendations:
- Try manually navigating to User Settings > Access Tokens
- Look for 'Personal Access Tokens' in your profile menu
- Check if RSS feed tokens are enabled in this GitLab instance
- Contact your GitLab administrator for assistance
